caption:
सुकेश चंद्रशेखर केस में नोरा फ़तेही को लेकर एक बड़ा अपडेट सामने आया है! 😲

दिल्ली की Rouse Avenue Court में EOW मामले की सुनवाई के दौरान नोरा की लीगल टीम ने बयान जारी कर साफ़ किया है कि वे इस केस में आरोपी नहीं हैं। 🚨

वकीलों का दावा है कि नोरा पर कोई आरोप नहीं है और उन्हें सिर्फ एक गवाह के तौर पर अदालत की मदद के लिए बुलाया गया है।

2 नवंबर को नोटिस बहुत कम समय पर मिलने और पहले से तय प्रोफेशनल काम की वजह से नोरा पेश नहीं हो पाईं, जिसके बाद कोर्ट ने सुनवाई टाल दी है। 📰

यह मामला सुकेश द्वारा दिल्ली की रोहिणी जेल से लगभग 200 करोड़ रुपये की रंगदारी वसूलने का है, जिसमें MCOCA के तहत चार्जशीट दाखिल हुई है।

नोरा ने पहले जांच में बताया था कि उनकी बातचीत सुकेश से सीधे नहीं, बल्कि उसकी पत्नी Leena Maria Paulose के जरिए होती थी।

क्या आपको लगता है कि गवाह के तौर पर नोरा का बयान इस केस में अहम मोड़ लाएगा? अपनी राय कमेंट्स में बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: Nora Fatehi's team issues statement, clarifies she is ‘not an accused’ in Sukesh Chandrashekhar case: ‘Summoned as a witness'
ctx.summary: Nora Fatehi’s legal team clarified she is not an accused in the case against Sukesh Chandrashekhar and was called only to assist the court as a witness.
ctx.text:
Actor Nora Fatehi 's legal team has clarified that she is neither an accused nor alleged to have committed any offence in the Sukesh Chandrashekhar case. The clarification comes after the Economic Offences Wing (EOW) matter was listed before the Rouse Avenue Court in Delhi on November 2, where Nora was summoned as a witness.
In a statement on Tuesday, her legal team said, “The EOW matter concerning Sukesh Chandra Shekhar was listed today before the Rouse Avenue Court, Delhi, where Nora Fatehi was summoned as a witness. Her advocates appeared before the Court and submitted that she had received the summons at a very short notice and was unable to attend due to prior professional commitments. An application seeking exemption from personal appearance was filed, following which the matter was adjourned to 6 November 2026, with fresh summons issued for her appearance.”
Also read: Aviation firm files ₹ 3 crore defamation suit against Nora Fatehi for ‘toy plane’ remark
“It is clarified that Nora Fatehi is neither an accused nor alleged to have committed any offence in these proceedings. She has been summoned solely as a witness to assist the Court,” they added.
The case pertains to allegations that Sukesh, while lodged in Delhi's Rohini Jail, impersonated senior government officials and extorted approximately ₹ 200 crore. The Delhi Police's Economic Offences Wing investigated the case and filed a chargesheet under the Maharashtra Control of Organised Crime Act (MCOCA).
Nora was earlier questioned by the EOW in connection with her alleged association with Chandrashekhar and his wife, Leena Maria Paulose. Her statement was recorded under Section 164 of the CrPC, following which she was named as a prosecution witness in the supplementary chargesheet. She had told investigators that her interactions with Chandrashekhar were through his wife.
